name: Ringnote Call Recorder
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a call recorder, voice memo or transcription app. A wide Unbounded headline over sky blue, then black and paper white artboards. A recording pill and an incoming call pill tilt across the first screenshot, a white phone leans over the edge onto the second, a waveform runs behind both, and a recorder pill, a file card and a summary chip pop out of the phones. Every part sits in named, editable layer groups, with each background colour and glow on a layer of its own. The star rating and the review are sample copy, marked in the group names: replace them with your own.
